# Tables {#sec-tables}
 
```{r} 
#| label: 'set-rda-dir-tbls'
#| echo: false 
#| warning: false 
#| eval: true 
#| include: false
library(flextable)
tables_dir <- 'C:/Users/samantha.schiano/Documents/GitHub/asar-demo/report/rda_files/tables'
``` 

```{r} 
#| label: 'tab-bnc-setup'
#| echo: false 
#| warnings: false 
#| eval: true
# if the table rda exists:
if (file.exists(file.path(tables_dir, 'bnc_table.rda'))){

# load rda
load(file.path(tables_dir, 'bnc_table.rda'))

# save rda with table-specific name
bnc_table_rda <- rda

# save table and caption as separate objects; set eval to TRUE
bnc_table <- bnc_table_rda$table
bnc_cap <- bnc_table_rda$cap
eval_bnc <- TRUE

# if the table rda does not exist, don't evaluate the next chunk
} else {eval_bnc <- FALSE}
``` 

```{r} 
#| label: 'tbl-bnc'
#| echo: false 
#| warnings: false 
#| tbl-cap: !expr if(eval_bnc) bnc_cap 
#| include: !expr eval_bnc
bnc_table
``` 

```{r} 
#| label: 'tab-indices.abundance-setup'
#| echo: false 
#| warnings: false 
#| eval: true
# if the table rda exists:
if (file.exists(file.path(tables_dir, 'indices.abundance_table.rda'))){

# load rda
load(file.path(tables_dir, 'indices.abundance_table.rda'))

# save rda with table-specific name
indices.abundance_table_rda <- rda

# save table and caption as separate objects; set eval to TRUE
indices.abundance_table <- indices.abundance_table_rda$table
indices.abundance_cap <- indices.abundance_table_rda$cap
eval_indices.abundance <- TRUE

# if the table rda does not exist, don't evaluate the next chunk
} else {eval_indices.abundance <- FALSE}
``` 

```{r} 
#| label: 'tbl-indices.abundance'
#| echo: false 
#| warnings: false 
#| tbl-cap: !expr if(eval_indices.abundance) indices.abundance_cap 
#| include: !expr eval_indices.abundance
indices.abundance_table
```
